purpose: Calendar-period stability and 30D-to-90D transfer of the working P25 signal and monthly sizing decisions
period_accounting: Continuous daily books sliced by calendar period; inventory is carried across boundaries. These are not independently reset tests or new holdouts.

sample_controls.full_proposal: Same 577 decision proposals per wing at both maturities; missing contracts reach explicit execution rejection
sample_controls.matched_signal_quotes: For each wing, same pair/date proposals with both contract pairs selected on the signal day at 30D and 90D; no future-path filter

unchanged: Stock hedge, funding, borrow and dividend assumptions
Hold each leg to its expiry and existing causal corporate exits
interpretation: The 30D P25 result is strongest in 2021-2023 and weak in 2024-partial2025. The existing decision stream does not transfer profitably to 90D. Quote availability changes the sample materially, but 90D also underperforms on matched signal dates. This is not a test of newly trained 90D-native signals or sizing. The 30D full-period 0.842 uses an earlier common entry cutoff and must not replace the unchanged 0.826 checkpoint as a purported new model best.
evidence_limits: Inspected history and no fresh holdout
Longer holdings can change execution eligibility, inventory and risk rejections
Matched signal availability is per wing, not a single common sample across all three wings
